news.title: Helms, gauntlets and amulets
items: Three new pieces to craft, in Volt, Pure Ether and Genesis: a helm takes less damage, gauntlets hit harder with a blade and mine faster, an amulet brings your hearts back sooner.
A new Character tab: your character among its slots, click one to choose what to wear, and everything it adds up to below.
What you wear shows on your character, for everyone around.

news.title: Fights that hit harder
items: Chain your blows with a blade: a slash, a backhand, then an overhead chop, each with its arc of light.
A blow that lands holds a split second and shakes the view; its damage rises from the mob, in gold for a critical one.
Struck mobs flinch, fallen ones topple over, and a hit you take knocks your head aside.

news.title: A world that moves
items: Doors swing open on their hinges, levers tip over, and a chest lifts its lid while you look inside.
A block you place grows into place; a block you mine flies to you.
Lie down in a bed, sit on a chair or a sofa, eat at a table: the players around you see it.

news.title: Emotes
items: Press G (or the smiley button) for a row of gestures everyone around you sees: Wave, Point, Cheer, Clap and Sit.
Typing /wave, /cheer, /sit... in the chat does the same.
Two new gestures in the Workshop aisle of the shop, Dance and Bow: try them on your character before buying.

news.title: A new guard
items: On guard, you now hold your blade upright, tip down, in front of you, both hands on the grip.
A parry shows: for a moment you step aside, the blade raised level above your head. The others see it too.

news.title: A new shop
items: The shop now has three aisles: the Store (premium pieces and sets), the Workshop (everything bought with Gwei) and the Wardrobe.
Each week the Store shows one premium set, with a button to try the whole set on at once.
Premium sets can be bought whole for less than their pieces; already own some? You only pay for the share you are missing.
The Wardrobe keeps up to four outfits: save what you wear, and put it all back on in one tap.

news.title: Creatures of the land
items: The dunes, forests, plains and snowy peaks have their own creatures now.
Gas Scorpion, in the dunes at night: it stings from afar with a bolt of gas.
Phishing Spider, in the forests at night: beware its gold coin, it pounces.
Pump Slime, on the plains at night: it hops toward you.
Cold Wallet Yeti, on the snowy peaks, day and night: slow and tough, its blows throw you far.
Leaves, pink leaves, palm fronds and grass blocks are picked up when you break them, to build with.
New blocks to lay paths (Crafting → Construction): Dirt Path, Gravel Path and Paving Stones.
Critical blows: strike while coming down from a jump for 50% more damage, and any blow has a small chance to be critical.
On your hovercraft, you now turn with it: no more spinning apart from it in a fast turn.
A player holding the Plasma Pistol now holds it out toward where they aim.

news.title: Softer land
items: The edges of steps, cliffs and tree crowns look rounded, like modelling clay: the land reads as one soft mass.
Grass wraps over the rounded edges, and inside corners curve smoothly too.
Players and villagers have softer, rounded shapes.
Your health shows as a life bar instead of a row of hearts: a pale trail shows what a blow just took.
A creature you strike shows its own life bar over its head for a few seconds.
Walking backwards is slower than walking forwards.
Gliding with the Titan’s cape: arms spread like wings, no more running in the air.
Settings → On screen: hide what you don’t need (position, players online, gear, Gwei, objective, aimed block, names over heads).

news.title: The sound of the ground
items: Footsteps, mining and building sound like what they touch again: grass, sand, snow, wood, glass and stone each have their own.

news.title: Fairer fights
items: Mobs stop a step away to strike instead of walking into you: your guard and your parries now catch every blow from in front.
/invite and /kick work again: let a friend build on your plots, or take it back.
Pink foxes roam the forests again: pet one and it picks you a flower, once a day.

news.title: Version 1
items: Your account is your nickname and a password: enter with them on any device to find your game. Got a temporary password? The game asks you to choose your own.
Plots cost Gwei: 500 for the first, twice as much for each next one, 9 at most per world.
A wiki, linked from this screen: controls, chapters, crafting, mobs, validators, plots, the shop.
On a phone: spaced action buttons, a button to ride a hovercraft, and the character stays in view in the shop while you try things on.
On a phone, drag your finger while firing the pistol to turn and aim.
This update log, right here.

news.title: Animations and models
items: Seen from behind, your blows and your guard match what you see in first person, and the other players see them too.
Mobs flash when struck, wind up before they strike (raise your guard right then), and burst into cubes when they fall.
Jumps, landings, runs, swims and ladder climbs have their own moves.
Every item you hold has its own clay model, doors, fences and plants included.
Holding jump in the water, you float half in it instead of bouncing on the surface.
Faster start, and the game keeps where you stand even when you only walk.

news.title: Shop, towers and validators
items: The shop sells every look, with variants of outfits, hats, capes, wings, backpacks, trails and pickaxe trims.
Bigger towers and Merge Sanctum: more room to fight.
Validators need an attestation once every 8 days, not every day.

news.title: The game server
items: Players, mobs, fights and loot now go through the game server: smoother multiplayer and fair fights.
Front-Runner Boots: worn on your feet, with a dodge (Q, or the lightning button).
Claiming a plot shows it to you first.

news.title: The clay look
items: A new look for the whole world: soft clay shapes, glow, aurora and clouds.
Guard and parry with a blade: raise it just before a blow and the mob reels.
Diamond Gliders: hovercrafts to ride, twice as fast and over water too.
The Mempool: an open-air colosseum and its boss, the Front-Runner.
